newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Proton says to start exports to Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Proton says to start exports to Lebanon.

text.p: Malaysian car maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) said on Tuesday it would sign an agreement with a Lebanese company to make Lebanon Proton's 44th export market.
Proton said in a statement the agreement would be signed with the Malaysian Lebanese Trading House, and would take place on Tuesday in the presence of Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
Proton said it currently exports to Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain.

"For the year 1997 it is envisaged that 1,200 units of Proton vehicles will be exported to the Middle Eastern market," said Proton. It did not say how many vehicles are being exported to the region currently.
There are currently no vehicle production or assembly plants in Lebanon, said Proton.
